column1: # Multipliers on the patterns of patterns.tsv by the language names are written in (curated
# 2026-11-10); a language without a row keeps them. Chinese names are mostly a place, a coined
# trade name of two characters and the trade (上海华信贸易有限公司), rarely a person's name;
# Japanese names keep the family name (鈴木商店) beside coined ones; Russian and other post-Soviet
# names are often a coined word in quotes (ООО «Ромашка»); German, Italian and Turkish ones keep the
# founder's name more often than English ones. Curated estimates, not measured.
